item_name: Unstageable Pressure Ulcers/Injuries Related to Non-removable Dressing/Device
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND for this item. The M0300E section (pp. M-21 to M-22) states only that the assessor enters the number of pressure ulcers/injuries that are unstageable related to a non-removable dressing/device (i.e., currently present) and the number first noted at admission/entry or reentry; it does not state an observation/look-back window. A 7-day look-back is stated in the gating item M0210 (p. M-5, "Code based on the presence of any pressure ulcer/injury (regardless of stage) in the past 7 days"), but that statement is made for M0210, not for M0300E, so it is not carried forward here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Known pressure ulcers/injuries covered by a non-removable dressing/device (e.g., primary surgical dressing, cast) are coded as unstageable; "Known" means documentation is available that says a pressure ulcer/injury exists under the non-removable dressing/device.

source.quote: Known pressure ulcers/injuries covered by a non-removable dressing/device (e.g., primary surgical dressing, cast) should be coded as unstageable. “Known” refers to when documentation is available that says a pressure ulcer/injury exists under the non-removable dressing/device.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Present on admission determination (applies to each pressure ulcer/injury, including those coded at M0300E): determine if the ulcer/injury was present at the time of admission/entry or reentry and not acquired while the resident was in the care of the nursing home; consider current and historical levels of tissue involvement.

source.quote: For each pressure ulcer/injury, determine if the pressure ulcer/injury was present at the time of admission/entry or reentry and not acquired while the resident was in the care of the nursing home. Consider current and historical levels of tissue involvement.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If a pressure ulcer/injury was unstageable on admission/entry or reentry and then becomes numerically stageable later, it is considered "present on admission" at the stage at which it first becomes numerically stageable; a subsequent increase in numerical stage is not coded as present on admission.

source.quote: If the pressure ulcer/injury was unstageable on admission/entry or reentry, then becomes numerically stageable later, it should be considered as “present on admission” at the stage at which it first becomes numerically stageable.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If a pressure ulcer/injury was unstageable on admission/entry or reentry and then becomes unstageable for another reason, it is considered "present on admission" at the new unstageable status.

source.quote: If a pressure ulcer/injury was unstageable on admission/entry or reentry and then becomes unstageable for another reason, it should be considered “present on admission” at the new unstageable status.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A resident admitted with documentation that a pressure ulcer/injury is present under a cast that cannot be removed is coded on the Admission assessment as an unstageable pressure ulcer/injury due to non-removable dressing/device (M0300E1 = 1 and M0300E2 = 1, present on admission/entry or reentry).

source.quote: Because the resident was admitted to the nursing facility with documentation that a pressure ulcer/injury was present under the cast, and the cast could not be removed for the first two weeks, the pressure ulcer is coded on the Admission assessment as an unstageable pressure ulcer/injury due to non-removable dressing/device.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When a known ulcer/injury under a non-removable dressing/device is coded unstageable and present on admission at M0300E, and the dressing is later removed revealing a numerical stage that subsequently worsens, the higher stage is not coded as present on admission (example: M0300E1 = 1 and M0300E2 = 1 on admission; on the subsequent assessment M0300C1 = 1 and M0300C2 = 0).

source.quote: On admission, code M0300E1 as 1, unstageable pressure ulcer/injury due to non-removable dressing/device, and M0300E2 as 1, present on admission/entry or reentry.
